# 0.7.0 benchmark accounting and attribution / 试验审计

Prepared 2026-10-30. These tools only inspect retained reports/traces; they do not
change task oracles, thresholds, paid attempts or the running model controls.

## First round accounting / 首轮停止记录

The retained first report schedules 72 attempts. Trace-backed accounting found
9 recorded completed attempts, 1 interrupted/unsettled attempt, and 62 unstarted
attempts. A prelisted schedule is not evidence that every attempt ran.

The interrupted attempt was 1-medium_exact_source-v070. Its last observed
cumulative usage was 162,074 input tokens (139,136 cached), 786 output tokens,
162,860 total tokens, across eight usage updates. Count the latest cumulative
total once; do not sum those eight cumulative updates.

Known first-round usage, including that partial trace:

| Arm | Input | Cached input | Output | Total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0.6.1 | 874,990 | 775,552 | 4,622 | 879,612 |
| 0.7.0 first candidate | 646,611 | 539,264 | 3,456 | 650,067 |
| Combined known lower bound | 1,521,601 | 1,314,816 | 8,078 | 1,529,679 |

In-flight usage not yet reported at termination remains unknown. These are
consumption totals, not a saving comparison: the arms have unequal completed
tasks and the candidate was interrupted. Original failed/incomplete artifacts
remain retained and are not replaced by the repaired candidate's new round.

首轮 72 项只是预排计划；不是执行了 72 项。9 项有完整记录、1 项中断、62 项未启动。
中断项未上报的在途 token 无法补算，必须保持未知。已知消耗不能因新一轮而消失。

Evidence: verification/v070-first-usage-audit.json, generated by
tests/audit_stopped_v070.py. The original report remains unedited.

## Graceful stop and resume / 优雅停止与续跑

The final harness accepts --stop-file verification/stop-v070-final.flag.
When that file exists, it finishes the current two-arm pair and stops before
starting the next pair. It records interrupted=true, complete=false, stop time,
reason and completed-attempt count. It does not stop a running command midway.

--resume is allowed only for such a graceful stop with no active attempt and an
even number of recorded attempts. It verifies identical model, effort, source,
runtime, guidance, schedule, evaluation files and acceptance hash. All recorded
attempts, including failures, are skipped and retained. A hard-killed attempt
cannot silently be resumed/retried through this path. Remove the stop file before
continuing if continuation is desired; an existing stop file causes another stop.

Default new report is verification/v070-costs-final.json. Existing reports are
never silently overwritten as a new round. Nine fixture/harness tests cover the
stop boundary, retained failures and rejection of changed-model/in-flight resume.

## Outer versus inner actions / 外层与原生调用

The host's recorder saves item/completed, turn/completed and token usage events.
It does not save rawResponseItem/completed payloads that could reveal outer
functions.exec outputs. Native commandExecution/McpToolCall counts are therefore
not outer exec counts, nor the count of internal native-worker subprocesses.

The first nine trial thread IDs had no matching local rollout files. The trials
are ephemeral. Outer exec counts are unavailable, not zero. The audit script
also looks for matching rollout filenames and, when found, deduplicates
custom_tool_call/function_call records by call_id. It extracts only output
reference IDs, not full user messages or reasoning.

Worker launch count could later be measured around files._invoke_worker's
subprocess.run boundary with operation, trusted context, elapsed time and status.
That would alter production measurement code and is not introduced into this
frozen round. A command count inferred from workflows must not be called an
observed worker-launch count.

## Display-induced retrieval / 展示诱发补读

tests/audit_v070_tool_chains.py extracts each ops_result call with up to three
preceding native tool actions, source event line numbers, references and optional
observed reference origins. Text is bounded; user prompts/reasoning are excluded.

Every retrieval starts as unknown. Being raw, following a large output, or using
a nonzero offset is not proof of avoidable retrieval. In particular, native MCP
results are not necessarily the text emitted through functions.exec to the model.

Manual annotation labels:
- display_missing_evidence: positive causal evidence that the model-visible
  presentation omitted task-needed content already acquired, and that one useful
  initial presentation could have avoided this retrieval.
- source_pagination_required: required source data had not yet been acquired.
- task_requires_full_content: task explicitly requires full exact content; explain
  whether presentation avoidance is actually possible, rather than assuming.
- explicit_query_new_evidence: a new evidence need/query, not a display repair.
- unknown: evidence does not distinguish these cases.

Non-unknown labels require cited evidence. Positive display_missing_evidence
also requires modelVisibleEvidence, evidenceNeed and whyAvoidable fields.
Do not classify from tool-call count alone. Unknown cases block a point estimate;
a zero baseline denominator also yields UNKNOWN. The fixed target remains 50%.

有同一个引用的后续 raw 调用，不足以证明“压缩害我多调用一次”。必须看到模型收到的
展示、缺失内容与任务需求。不能用总引用次数替换因果指标。证据不足就保留 UNKNOWN。

## Workflow adoption / 工作流采用

The script reports workflowByOperation and tasksWithWorkflow from actual MCP
arguments. The eligible opportunity denominator requires separate task review,
so naturalAdoptionRate stays null. This is controlled benchmark routing with
version-specific guidance, not proof of everyday adoption.

Among the first nine completed attempts, baseline had workflows in 4/5 tasks
(locate four calls, incremental one), candidate in 4/4 (investigate five calls).
These unequal early samples are not an adoption-rate comparison.
Neither arm had an ops_result call in those nine completed attempts, so a 50%
display-induced retrieval reduction cannot be computed.

## Timing and treatment / 时序与处理差异

wallSeconds begins after Host construction and immediately before host.run;
it includes initialization, readiness and MCP discovery, then stops when the
model run returns. It excludes fixture preparation, the Host constructor/Popen
segment, native oracle evaluation and the subsequent telemetry snapshot.
endedAt is recorded after those trailing operations. Do not mix the two measures
or label wallSeconds as complete task end-to-end latency.

The actual version skill and active SessionStart text are eagerly injected as
developerInstructions. Hooks are not executed in this model trial; dynamic daily
skill loading is not replicated. Model and effort are explicitly equal in both
arms, with sequential paired/interleaved ordering. Guidance changes are part of
the treatment, not a controlled-away variable.
